tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Lightweight liveness probe for the Harmony Holistics platform. Use this first to confirm the API is reachable before calling any other tool. Returns {"status":"ok","service":"harmony-holistics-api"} on success.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List the 15 free self-assessments (all free, no account required). Use this to discover which assessment matches a user's concern before recommending one. Returns an array of assessment objects, each with an id and a display name.

tools.name: search_herbs
tools.description: Search the 144-herb apothecary by name, Spanish synonym, action, or wellness goal. Use this when a user asks about a specific herb, a symptom, or a wellness goal. Returns up to 20 herb objects with name, actions, traditional uses, and contraindications.

tools.name: list_researchers
tools.description: List the 21 cited researchers and the assessments they ground. Use this when a user asks who informs the platform's methodology. Returns an array of researcher objects with name and their contribution.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List published educational blog posts (title, slug, category, excerpt). Use this to find articles on parasite cleansing, polyvagal theory, attachment, sleep, and traditional herbalism. Returns an array of post objects with title, slug, category, and excerpt.

tools.name: list_wellness_stacks
tools.description: [Pro] List the 9 condition-specific wellness stacks (Rooted Health). Use this to recommend a structured, condition-focused framework to a user. Returns stack objects with a title and phased detail. Requires a Core Breath MCP Pro key from teosharmony.com/mcp.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: [Pro] List the 11 instant-download digital guides. Use this when a user wants an in-depth book or guide rather than a short answer. Returns book objects with title and price. Requires a Core Breath MCP Pro key from teosharmony.com/mcp.

tools.name: list_parasites
tools.description: [Pro] List the parasite encyclopedia organisms (name, slug, category, key symptoms). Use this when a user asks about a specific parasite or parasite-related symptoms. Returns organism objects with name, slug, category, and key symptoms. Requires a Core Breath MCP Pro key from teosharmony.com/mcp.

tools.name: analyze_results
tools.description: [Pro] Personalized deep analysis of assessment results. Use this to turn a client's completed assessment scores into a structured, actionable report. Pass assessments as an array of objects, each with questionnaire_type (e.g. 'standard', 'morse', 'sleep', 'ace', 'attachment', 'burnout', 'self_compas

tools.name: get_herb
tools.description: Get full details for a single herb by name or Spanish synonym. Use this after search_herbs when you need one herb's complete record. Returns an object with the herb's name, Spanish name, category, actions, uses, and contraindications.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: Get details for a single assessment by id. Use this to confirm an assessment's purpose before recommending it or passing its scores to analyze_results. Returns an object with the assessment's id and name.

tools.name: get_parasite
tools.description: Get full details for a single parasite by slug. Use this after list_parasites when a user asks about one specific organism. Returns an object with organism, category, symptoms, and details.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Get details for a single book by id or slug. Use this when a user asks about one specific guide. Returns an object with the book's id, title, slug, and description.

tools.name: get_researcher
tools.description: Get full details for a single researcher by name. Use this when a user asks about a specific researcher's contribution. Returns an object with name, domains, contribution, and the assessments it grounds.

tools.name: get_wellness_stack
tools.description: Get full details for a single wellness stack by id. Use this after list_wellness_stacks when a user wants one stack's complete phases. Returns an object with the stack's title, summary, and phases.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Get a single blog post by slug, including its full text. Use this when a user asks about one specific article. Returns an object with title, slug, category, excerpt, and content.

tools.name: get_detox_programs
tools.description: List the fasting and body-detox offerings (guides, self-check assessment, wellness stacks, consultations). Use this when a user asks about fasting, a cleanse, or a detox program. Returns the fasting + detox guides, the parasite/heavy-metal self-check, the detox-pathway wellness stack, and the consul

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "health_check" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lightweight liveness probe for the Harmony Holistics platform. Use this first to confirm the API is reachable before calling any other tool. Returns {"status":"…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_herb · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_herb · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
